title: Como eu aprendi a aprender (e por que a IA não veio pra pensar por você)
why_read: A personal reflective essay in Portuguese about learning to code before and after AI tools, offering anecdote rather than technical depth.
analysis: This is a personal narrative from a developer describing their journey learning to program starting in 2022, contrasting the old Stack-Overflow-driven learning process with the arrival of AI coding assistance. It reflects on how the friction of manual research and trial-and-error previously forced deeper understanding of problems. There's no concrete technical content, benchmark, or tool being introduced here, just a personal essay on learning philosophy. It may resonate with junior developers reflecting on their own growth but offers little for a technical audience seeking substantive engineering content.
